author: blu
body: prose-blocks and annotations ride through from the Document so that per-definition prose (each block carries its anchor) and the raw annotation nodes survive past desugaring. rt-names, rt-budgets, and conversions remain the distilled views the checker and desugarer consume; the raw lists exist for emission.

author: blu
body: The guarded form, for the frontend keep copy. The keep reservation sits BELOW the DESUGAR deck this copy reads, so a copy that outgrows the floor writes into its own source and dereferences the overwrite.

author: blu
body: Every list field that scales with the source is a guarded loop, and every remaining field is skipped once the frontier is past the ceiling. Guards on the defs and type-def loops alone are not enough: prose-blocks carries one entry per prose paragraph in the unit, which for the concatenated compiler is the same order as the definitions.
